pages.text: A fast Iron-tier weapon. Each Villager killed with it permanently adds 2.5% damage to that dagger, up to 100% after 40 kills.$(br2)Villager Soul drops are twice as likely when the killing blow comes from the dagger. It cannot receive Unbreaking or Mending.
